newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint ends firmer vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint ends firmer vs dollar.

text.p: Hungary's forint ended firmer against the dollar in very thin Friday trade on Budapest's inter-bank forex market.
At the close the forint stood at 155.65/70, right on the central bank's resistance level, which stood at 155.64 at midday. The unit opened at 155.75/80 to the dollar.
"We can say that practically there was zero turnover today," said Peter Luczo of Inter-Europa Bank.
Luczo said investors' attention had turned away from the Hungarian unit to other currencies.
